We need to propose a retrosynthesis route with 6 reactions for target SMILES: O=S(NC1=CC(N2CCN(C(OC(C)(C)C)=O)CC2)=C3C(CCC4(CCC4)O3)=C1)(C5=C(F)C=CC=C5)=O

We have already applied template 20810 to get two precursors: "CC(C)(C)OC(=O)N1CCN(c2cc(N)cc3c2OC2(CCC2)CC3)CC1" and "O=S(=O)(Cl)c1ccccc1F". So first disconnection: sulfonamide formation from sulfonyl chloride and amine.

Now need to further disconnect each fragment.

Fragment A: the amine part (the complex heterocycle). It contains a carbamate (tert-butyl carbonate) attached to N of piperazine? Actually N1CCN(C(OC(C)(C)C)=O)CC1 attached to aromatic ring via an aniline (N attached to aromatic). So we can consider disconnection of carbamate to give amine and t-butyl chloroformate? But typical deprotection: carbamate can be formed from amine + chloroformate (Cl-CO-OtBu). So retro step: break carbamate to give amine (the N of piperazine) and t-butyl chloroformate (ClC(=O)OC(C)(C)C). However we need a template for carbamate formation. Search for carbamate formation template. Use search for functional_groups_formed carbamate and broken alkyl halide maybe. Let's search for template that forms carbamate from amine and chloroformate.
